reason: I already treat settlement emails as spam, and a free site I have never heard of that wants an account so I can still file the form myself just feels like a data grab. Easy money is tempting, but I am not handing over my info for a list I have to verify on the official site anyway.

would_change_my_mind: If my bank or a store I already shop at sent me here with no account required, and it only linked to an official no-proof claim I clearly qualified for.
